_comment: What to read out of Hugging Face's Inference Providers router listing.
It names PARTNERS, not routes. Which models a partner serves through the router is
Hugging Face's business and changes constantly; following that is the whole point
of this job. A route a partner adds is published on the next run, one it stops
serving keeps its last observed prices and gains an 'absent_since' stamp, and both
show up as + / ~ lines in the run summary and the commit.
There is no hand-written route list, and there must not be one. The router states
the model id and the partner itself, so nothing needs translating by hand.
Two partners are covered, by request: ovhcloud and scaleway. Widening the set is a
one-line change to 'partners' -- and nothing else, since the routes follow.
The unit of pricing on this source is a (model, partner) PAIR, not a model. The
same model is served by both partners at different prices, so the key is the string
the router itself takes, '<model id>:<partner>', the form Hugging Face's own
documentation uses ("openai/gpt-oss-120b:ovhcloud"). A key without the suffix
would name two different prices at once.
A price here is what the partner charges THROUGH the router, which is not the price
of calling that partner directly. OVHcloud's own catalog prices Qwen3.6-27B at 0.40
EUR; the router quotes 0.47 USD for the same model on the same partner. Both are
correct and both are in this file, under their own provider. providers.huggingface
is not a cross-check of providers.ovh.
Currency is USD, and the figures are already per MILLION tokens -- no scaling is
applied, unlike Eden AI's per-token source. Confirmed by cross-checking the
ovhcloud routes against OVH's own EUR catalog, which this repository publishes
independently under providers.ovh: every one tracks at the USD/EUR rate (0.40 EUR
agreeing to the conversion rate is what pins the unit and the currency here.
A route whose status is not 'live' is treated as not offered rather than published:
a price for a call that cannot be served is worse than no price. It is not deleted
either -- it keeps its last observed prices under an 'absent_since' stamp, the same
as a route that vanished outright. A route Hugging Face marks is_free is published
with the shared "free": true marker and no price field, the same as OVH's free
models -- never as a price of 0.
